describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal animal with the overall body shape, dense shaggy brown fur, and head of a bear, standing in profile facing right. Its body is covered in thick brown fur that is lighter on the muzzle and darker on the legs. Integrated into the fur are glossy, dark reddish-brown, hard beetle-like structures and two large translucent membranous wings. A long segmented glossy tail extends from the rear. Rows of narrow dark slits are visible in the fur on the side and hip.

describe.description: The creature is a stocky four-legged shaggy brown bear shown standing in profile facing right, with insect features merged into its body. Its body, head, ears, legs and paws are those of a brown bear with thick brown fur. Set into the fur of its shoulders, neck and side are several glossy dark reddish-brown beetle wing-covers, with large translucent tan membranous insect flight wings with brown veins extending outward from the sides of its torso. Rows of dark slit-like openings run along the fur on its flanks, and instead of a bear tail it has a long segmented armored dark insect tail with small spines and a forked tip hanging from its rear.
